request.business_problem: Team leads check the ticketing system by hand to find breaching tickets and summarise queues.
request.tasks: Let Claude read tickets from our ticketing system REST API, read-only: list open tickets (filter by queue and priority), get one ticket with its comments, and list tickets past their SLA. No creating, closing or commenting.
request.existing_tools: Ticketing system with REST API at https://tickets.copperline.example/api (bearer token)
request.required_output: Tables of tickets with id, subject, priority, queue, age and SLA status.

smoke.prompt: Use the ticket tools to list the open tickets that have breached their SLA.
